description: Replaces the text of an existing message (updateMask=text; the previous text is overwritten, not appended). With user authentication only the authenticated user's OWN messages can be edited — editing someone else's returns PERMISSION_DENIED, a Chat rule, not a missing scope. The message keeps its name and thread; lastUpdateTime is set and clients show an Edited marker. Updating cards or accessory widgets needs app auth via raw_request.

message.description: The full message name from list_messages/send_message, e.g. "spaces/AAA/messages/BBB.CCC".

text.description: The new message text (replaces the old text entirely).

name: update_message
title: Update a message
